hero.title: File:Candlelit Vigil for Brianna Ghey in George Square, Glasgow.jpg
hero.source: Candlelit Vigil for Brianna Ghey in George Square, Glasgow
hero.description: After Brianna Ghey, a 16 year old trans girl, was stabbed to death, there were protests and candlelight vigils across the UK. This photo is of one of three benches full of candles, cards, flowers and placards after the vigil in George Square, Scotland.

gallery.description: A pop-up memorial in Queen Victoria Square, Kingston upon Hull to Brianna Ghey, a 16-year-old trans girl brutally murdered on 11 February 2023 in a premeditated stabbing in Culcleth by Scarlett Jenkinson and Eddie Ratcliffe.
